title: splash and icon are always in the pck even for mods or addon pcks
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6.1 and all the previous versions, probably.

### System information

linux

### Issue description

I am making a browser based game. In order to speed up initial load time (#41118) I have split the game up into several pck files, lazy loaded on demand, e.g. one for each game level.

Every single pck generated includes a duplicate copy of the splash png and the icon though, no matter what tricks I pull with import settings, exclusion filters or export plugins. Seemingly the only way to make them disappear is to remove them from the project settings.

I have resorted to doing that for my project and instead I manually add images to the html template, which is an ok workaround for web projects, especially because you can also use webp instead of png that way. Obviously doesn't work for addons or mods of desktop/mobile games, though I guess you could automate changing the project settings via a script before each export.

It's probably not a big deal at the end of the day, most people are just making a single pck, but some splash images can be 500KB or more and having 30 copies around isn't ideal. It would be nice if the exclusion filters were respected, but I understand this probably isn't the highest priority and maybe it isn't that clear what the intended behaviour should ultimately be, so feel free to mark as wont fix.

### Steps to reproduce

export the MRP then open up the exported pck to discover the unwanted images inside

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[splash-icon-pck-exclude.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25595451/splash-icon-pck-exclude.zip)
